title: Reconciled Recovery State v2 + fail-closed completion gate

source_provenance.notes: v2 state schema + completion gate; 11/11 unit smoke reported on candidate branch

problem_or_opportunity: The verified v1 transcript extractor intentionally stops at EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED. A separate semantic state is needed to partition projects, verify claims, resolve authority/currentness, journal writes and prove recovery completion before returning to normal production.
proposed_mechanism: Immutable v1 evidence -> Reconciled Recovery State v2 -> project partitions -> claim/evidence verification -> unknown/conflict disposition -> transactional write/readback -> fail-closed RECOVERY_COMPLETE -> normal next-action resolver.
expected_benefit: Prevents chat claims from silently becoming current state while allowing a pasted conversation to recover real work and resume from the verified frontier without Founder manual reconstruction.
pilot_evidence: PR67 unit completion-gate smoke 11/11 PASS as candidate evidence
red_team_findings: Unit tests do not prove semantic recovery quality on real large corpora
PR67 must remain candidate until real corpus and next-action integration regression
No duplicate v2 authority should be created
application_targets: normal next-action resolver after completion gate
next_action: Run first real large pasted-corpus end-to-end pilot, add evidence-adapter + next-action integration regression, then decide HOLD/PROMOTE/REVISE.
notes: Sprint 2 candidate. PR67 remains draft and not CURRENT.
